text.title: Cats Cute Miner
text.short_description: Lead cute cats into the mines, collect gear, and build a stronger mining team.
text.full_description:
Put your cat crew to work in an underground mining adventure. Your cats choose targets, dig through rocks, fill their bags, and bring the coins back to base. Spend the coins they deliver to improve the whole team.

BUILD YOUR MINING CREW
Upgrade mining power, movement, carrying capacity, unloading speed, and the value of your haul. Tap rocks to lend your cats a helping paw.

EXPLORE 144 MINES
Open gates and uncover branching tunnels as you work through the campaign. Finish the current mine and move on to the next challenge.

COLLECT LASTING UPGRADES
Equip pickaxes, hats, backpacks, and boots. Collect cards and improve their bonuses. Your equipment and card progress carry into the next mine, while local mine upgrades start fresh.

RETURN TO YOUR CATS
Your saved crew can make progress while you are away. Come back, collect the results, and decide what to upgrade next.

Optional in-app purchases are available. Randomized card chests have their chances shown in the game. Optional rewarded advertisements are available only to eligible users when enabled and permitted by their privacy choices.
